ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels; right lobe is predominantly high-intensity, left lobe is predominantly low-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe contains a high-intensity (white) field with distinct low-intensity (black) linear streaks and a dark medial patch. Left lobe contains a low-intensity (black) field with high-intensity (white) mottling and speckling concentrated along the upper margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 115 degrees; depth is minimal relative to total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge features high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Left lobe trailing edge features irregular, medium-amplitude peaks towards the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave curvature; distal tips exhibit a sharp convex upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast textured clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; scattered dark circular spots present on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of parallel, low-intensity diagonal linear markings (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity background of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips, significantly altering the 2D geometric profile of the lobe ends.
